title: What Jean Goldkette was like

blocks.x: Okay. Then you went to Jean Goldkette.
And that was the leading jazz band of the twenties, I'm sure.
Okay. Tell me what do you remember about the man, Jean Goldkette.
What kind of a person was he?
Did you have much dealings with him?
Because he didn't lead the band, did he?
So did you see very much of him?
When you saw him, what was he? Was he a businessman or was he a musician?
He was quite a charming man. He had a French accent, a nice nice French accent.
Was he a tall man, a short man?
That's pretty tall. Okay, he put together a very talented group but he himself was not part of the music.
To tell you the absolute truth, you just can't....
